about: Project art the 2026 kit fill rules read at build time (mod_editor/core/nfl2k5_kit_rule_fill.py, ART). Each file is the SOFTDRINK league project's own picture, byte for byte, pinned by SHA-256 in the rows that read it.

bal_dark_mark_2026.png.from: Wikimedia Commons, "Baltimore Ravens Uniforms (2026).png" (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Baltimore_Ravens_Uniforms_(2026).png), by TheGoodGeneral 1, own work, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0); cropped and cut out, nothing redrawn: crop box (5250, 40, 5850, 640), the mark's own grey outline ring with its holes filled as alpha (the b81 art lane's realmark.mark()), cropped to that alpha
bal_dark_mark_2026.png.licence: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. Attribution: "Baltimore Ravens Uniforms (2026)" by TheGoodGeneral 1, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0; cropped to the alternate helmet's mark
bal_dark_mark_2026.png.used_by: the real_mark step (realmark.apply: beta 80's stand-in raven drawing replaced by the real mark), rows 02A3/02H3 chunk 12 of data/nfl2k5_kit_fixes_2026_b81.json
bal_dark_mark_2026.png.what: Baltimore Ravens 2026 dark alternate (ALT 2) helmet mark, the front-facing raven head, 229 x 292 RGBA, alpha 0 or 255
